product_updates.title: As AI-led attacks multiply, OpenAI launches a new cyber model
product_updates.content: OpenAI is expanding its AI cybersecurity defense program Daybreak, and rolling out a new cyber-trained AI model with it.

product_updates.title: Mark Zuckerberg’s AI manifesto is exactly why people don’t like AI
product_updates.content: On Monday, Mark Zuckerberg published a 6,500-word manifesto about personal AI, largely about the possibilities for the "personal superintelligence" systems Meta AI is building.

product_updates.title: Tech industry is buzzing after a Claude agent hacked into a gym
product_updates.content: An OpenClaw agent hacked into a gym's reservation system to bump its human boss higher on a class' waitlist. And the tech industry took notice.

product_updates.title: Meta’s new Glimmer AI model offers a hint at Zuckerberg’s personal intelligence vision
product_updates.content: Meta’s new open-weight Muse Glimmer model offers a glimpse of Mark Zuckerberg’s personal superintelligence vision, as well as the emerging divide between AI users can own and access.

product_updates.title: Discovered Materials is playing AI whack-a-mole to hunt cooler chips
product_updates.content: Discovered Materials raised $9 million to fund the hunt for more novel materials to build more efficient chips.
